## **Ads pressure** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Ads pressure.**
      2 recent review(s) mention ads pressure.
      Review window: Oct 1, 2026 - Oct 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users are noticing ad pressure. This can signal monetization friction and an opening for a cleaner competitor.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Kaye Handlon_, Oct 1, 2026, 1/5: "I've been using this app for a few years now and while I know updates can be a little disturbing till you figure out how they've changed things. but this last update where you can't see your macros per meal without jumping through several screens, it's just ridiculous. I used to have the paid version but for whatever reason I saw no value in it. I'm fine with seeing the ads but geez, jumping through three different screens just to see my by meal macros is just annoying."
            2. _wild child_, Oct 3, 2026, 4/5: "I love MyFitnessPal. I have used it for more than 10 years. I was a premium on and off depending on my money situation. However, it became a too painful to use with too many unnecessary flashing ads for people with sensory conditions. Like, i don't mind the ads, but do they have to be flashing and moving? Also the celebratory pop-ups every time i log something, is there an option in the settings to disable that? It's too distracting. or how about creating an accessibility version of the app?"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Oct 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Nick Humphries_, Oct 3, 2026, 1/5: "for some reason the Garmin integration has degraded significantly. It now creates 10s of activities as duplicates, as it sees the activity come in from Garmin, and then creates it in MyFitnessPal, and then Creates a new one in Garmin (and the loop continues. Please fix this bug, it's the only way you can use the app effectively when doing diet tracking with an exercise routine."
            2. _Dominic Mancl_, Oct 3, 2026, 1/5: "app continously crashes on Galaxy S24 even after full uninstall reinstall. web version on mobile is unusable as well."
            3. _Stash Currie_, Sep 23, 2026, 1/5: "super slow, keeps crashing after recent updates, hella ads"
<!--/ir-theme-->
